name: Monet Punks
description: 10,000 CryptoPunk silhouettes painted in Claude Monet's impressionist style. Each portrait preserves the exact 24×24 pixel grid of the original CryptoPunks — male, female, zombie, ape, alien — rendered with soft impressionist dabs, broken color, and five Monet painting series as palettes. The first CryptoPunks derivative made with Claude (claude-sonnet-4.6). Built by Claude & Blue Pastel, 2026.
